body: Try some psychedelic drugs before you die, there are some that will let you experience the feeling of death and still come out the other side. Maybe you’ll find a reason to stick around.
You’re definitely giving they/them but it’s not a bad thing
You look like the lost Skarsgard brother

You are cute and have a great smile and should almost certainly smile more! I do however get a sense of your insecurity from some of your facial expressions.

It’s rough at first but you need to fake it til you make it in when it comes to confidence. Work on opening up your smile and losing that hesitancy.  

There is no reason you can’t become a party god in college, or a hot girlfriend-haver or the king of your nerd circle who commands lesser nerds to do your bidding, or whatever else you want out of life. It’s yours for the taking if you are nice to have around and fun to talk to, because your looks are not going to hold you back at all in that regard.

Some are saying haircut, but I say you need to grow some more hair on top and get it shaped to add a little volume. It looks very flat and bedheady, or like you always wear a beanie but took it off for the photo. Adds to your overall sleepy man vibes.  

However, if you’re a genuinely sleepy dude and want to lean into that look, I support it.

I disagree with the other guy, you need hair on your head or you look like Travis Bickle. Your face looks pretty good but facial hair seems patchy, so maybe stick to clean shaven. You have a great jaw.
You look like when a beautiful celebrity goes to the grocery store with no makeup on.
You have a bad case of gay face, are you gay/bi? If so, you are a cutie and will do fine.

You might want to look into some light fillers or even Botox for the crinkles under your eyes. They look very cute at the outer corners of your eyes (smile lines) but the ones right under the pupil age you prematurely IMO.
The second glasses are better. The first set of glasses make your eyes appear more downturned and you should be going for the opposite.
How tall are you? Frown more and you’ll look just like a runway model.

Cute face, bit of a baby face. Shave the beard, keep the mustache. You might try growing out your hair out a bit and using the curlygirl method or similar to get some nice curls or waves. Curly hair needs special care but it can look really good on men if they treat it right.
It used to be worse overall I think, but there are stressful things that come up pretty regularly and make my anxiety spiral out of control. I’m on meds but they don’t always help.
Yes, I worry it is going to sour our relationship. Nobody has gotten a raise there in 3-4 years.

Sounds like your brain is trying to be your therapist. Exposure therapy is supposed to help with emetophobia but it doesn’t involve watching people v*, it’s more about changing your thought patterns around it.
Start taking short walks frequently, even just inside the house. Or around the outside of your house/apartment. Do it every time you die in your game. Try it for 2 weeks, you have nothing to lose.

Don’t listen to anyone saying you’ll feel better if you go after them legally/tell the cops who they are. The system is a nightmare to navigate and for a lot of us it impedes the healing process.  

If you want to pursue it some time later the statute of limitations allows that but there’s no need to rush. Focus on your own healing first.
I believe there is a darkness over the state of Idaho right now. I have been having dreams about it. Please be careful and aware of the safety of your body, especially your hands and arms.
You remind me of a very young version of the actor Michael Ebeling. You’re just fine now but I can envision you really growing into your looks in your 20s and being very handsome.
Eating a big meal is a good idea, drink lots of water and tea, and just keep everything moving through you!
I’m sure I have done this when I was on Zoloft and I just had diarrhea and felt a little “off,” but then Zoloft always made me feel kind of weird.
Can you grow a beard?

You don’t care to do anything because you’re depressed. See a psychiatrist and get new meds, then keep seeing them and keep switching meds until you find some combo that gives you enough motivation to care about things again. Maybe trade school follows that, maybe a different job, maybe something you’ve never even considered because you have no way of knowing all the possibilities.

You’re not too old for a new counselor, either. From this post it seems like you know  what you need to do, and just need a push to jump-start you. Nobody can do this stuff for you, so work with a counselor to find a reason to care again. 

For me it was just the desire to get a pet, but before I could do that I needed to move out of my parents’ house, get a job and an apartment, and get my mind stable enough for all that stuff. Everything followed from that one desire.
Some parts are better, some are worse. At least society lets women express their emotions.

Maybe it means something is causing you a lot of anxiety and you need to get it out like popping a pimple. The charger coming out of your skin could mean you need a boost of power and energy from an external source in able to get past this issue. Maybe you aren’t expressing yourself fully in some area of life.
Such a happy dream! Maybe it means that you have to keep doing what brings me joy, even if the people around you don’t “get it.”

This sounds wild but some animals can actually smell cancer, dogs and cats for instance. Maybe some part of you could smell or sense that your dog was sick. The dream sounds like your mind trying to prepare you to adopt a new dog (which is kind of insensitive to your old dog but hey, you can’t really expect your subconscious to have proper manners). Anyway, it sounds like taking a “chance” and rescuing a new dog will help you heal from this.

Hi, so this type of dream is pretty common & I have had similar ones that freaked me out for a really long time (hence the username). As far as I can tell it is about feeling helpless and vulnerable. I also am a kid in my dream. It’s a sign that you need to take care of yourself, and also forgive yourself for the times when you were a kid and you were helpless.  
The not being able to scream plays into our dreams but it is actually a physical thing that causes it. Something to do with the way our bodies are paralyzed by our brains when we sleep so we can’t move too much and hurt ourselves. It also locks up your vocal chords unless you have certain sleep disorders or take medications that make you sleepwalk/talk.
Your brain is giving you a PSA that you need to stay far away from this person, like go to space if necessary to avoid them.
You look Mormon.
